app.name: AccessGrid Sync
login.title: Sign in
login.rate_limited.one: Too many failed attempts. Try again in about 1 minute.
login.rate_limited.many: Too many failed attempts. Try again in about {minutes} minutes.
wizard.title: Setup
wizard.step1.title: Create administrator account
wizard.step1.subtitle: This account is the only way to manage the sync tool. There is no password recovery — pick something you can remember or store it in a password manager.
wizard.step2.title: AccessGrid credentials
wizard.step2.subtitle: Enter your AccessGrid account ID and API secret. We'll test the connection before saving.
wizard.step3.title: Choose your PACS
wizard.step3.subtitle: Select which Physical Access Control System this NUC will sync from.
wizard.step4.title: PACS credentials
wizard.step4.subtitle: Enter the credentials for your PACS. We'll test the connection before saving.
wizard.step5.title: Setup complete
wizard.step5.subtitle: The sync engine will start automatically. Open the Status page to watch the first cycle run.
status.title: Sync status
credentials.title: Issued credentials
credentials.empty: No credentials issued yet. Run a sync to provision them.
logs.title: Logs
logs.empty: No log entries match the current filters.
settings.title: Settings
settings.site_code.saved: Site code updated. Newly issued credentials will use it.
settings.site_code.invalid: Site code must be a non-negative integer.
settings.site_code.not_configured: AccessGrid is not configured yet — finish the wizard first.
settings.dedupe.label: Skip provisioning when an AG card with the same site code + card number already exists
settings.dedupe.help: Enable on each instance when running multiple sync tools against separate PACS that share the same AccessGrid template.
settings.extra_metadata.help: Key/value pairs added to the metadata of every newly provisioned AccessGrid card. Existing cards aren't back-filled.
settings.extra_metadata.reserved_note: These keys are managed by the sync engine and can't be set here:
settings.extra_metadata.saved: Extra metadata saved. Newly provisioned cards will use it.
settings.extra_metadata.err.empty_key: Each row needs a non-empty key (or leave both fields blank to delete the row).
settings.extra_metadata.err.reserved: "{key}" is reserved by the sync engine and can't be used as extra metadata.
settings.extra_metadata.err.bad_chars: "{key}" has invalid characters. Use letters, digits, underscore, or hyphen.
settings.extra_metadata.err.too_long: "{key}" is too long. Limit is 64 characters.
alert.reconnect_required: The Millennium Ultra session has expired — syncing is paused.
connect.title: Reconnect to Millennium Ultra
connect.subtitle: Millennium's login is protected by a captcha, so the session has to be opened by a person. Click the button, sign in, and syncing resumes automatically.
connect.no_url: No Millennium Ultra URL is saved yet. Finish setup first.
wizard.connect.title: Connect to Millennium Ultra
wizard.connect.subtitle: Sign in to Millennium so the sync tool can read your cardholders. Your password is never seen or stored by this tool — only the session your browser receives.
wizard.connect.waiting: Waiting for you to complete Millennium Ultra log in…
wizard.connect.hint: A small browser window will open at the Millennium sign-in page. Complete the captcha and sign in, then return here.
wizard.connect.expired: That sign-in link expired before it was used.
wizard.connect.no_formats: Connected, but no card formats could be read from Millennium.
wizard.connect.not_registered: AG Connect is not registered on this machine yet. Run 'agsync register-uri' once, as the operator who will sign in, then reload this page.
wizard.connect.trigger_subtitle: Any cardholder holding a card in this format gets an AccessGrid pass on the next sync.
settings.notifications.title: Notifications
settings.notifications.subtitle: Where to send the 'sign in again' message when the Millennium session expires. Optional — the alert always appears in this UI and in the logs.
settings.notifications.use_ssl: Connect with SSL (port 465) instead of STARTTLS
settings.pacs_session.title: Millennium Ultra session
settings.trigger.title: Enrollment trigger
settings.trigger.subtitle: Cardholders holding a card in this format get an AccessGrid pass. Changing it re-decides who is enrolled: anyone holding only the old format is un-enrolled, and their pass is terminated on the next cycle.
settings.trigger.missing: The saved trigger (format {id}) no longer exists on this install — nothing is enrolled until you pick another.
settings.ok.trigger: Enrollment trigger saved. A sync has been queued.
settings.card_fields.title: Pass details
settings.card_fields.subtitle: Stamped on every pass this install issues. The title is used only where the PACS has no title of its own for the person. Changes apply to passes issued from now on, not to ones already out.
settings.email_domain.title: Synthesized email addresses
settings.email_domain.subtitle: This PACS stores no email addresses, so one is derived per cardholder as first.last.<record id>@<domain>. Changing the domain changes every address, and the new ones are pushed to AccessGrid on the next cycle — including for passes already issued.
settings.email_domain.label: Domain
settings.email_domain.saved: Email domain saved. A sync has been queued.
settings.email_domain.invalid: That does not look like a domain name.
alert.pacs_probably_disconnected: PACS PROBABLY DISCONNECTED — it returned no cardholders, so nothing is syncing.
